title: Rebuff
summary: REBUFF', noun 1. Repercussion, or beating back; a quick and sudden resistance. The strong rebuff of some tumultuous cloud. 2. Sudden check; defeat. 3. Refusal; rejection of solicitation. REBUFF', verb
